candidates.statement: Assume Demazure Surjectivity. This diagrammatic category is equivalent to the Karoubi envelope of DQ. It is also equivalent to Dstd Q , and to StdBimQ. Unfortunately, Kar(DQ) is not cyclic! It is worse than that the rotation of one bi- valent vertex is not the other. The bivalent vertex itself is not invariant under 360 degree twisting, being off by a sign. Any morphism with an even number of biva- lent vertices will be cyclic (i.e. invariant under 360 degree twists), but this still does not imply that twisting by 180 degrees is equal to rotation by 180 degrees, because bivalent vertices do not behave this way consistently. candidates.statement: If one is familiar with the geometric underpinning of Soergel bimod- ules, then it should not be terribly off-putting that these maps are not cyclic. One expects cyclicity whenever one analyzes convolution between perverse sheaves, be- cause the procedure of taking the biadjoint of a sheaf is a functor. Soergel bimodules are the equivariant (derived) global sections of the semisimple perverse sheaves on the ﬂag variety, and taking global sections is a well-behaved functor on this semisim- ple category, so that cyclicity happens to be preserved.
